messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED - kv-cache eviction rate spiked 12x in us-west-2. Observability alert: tail latency increase and increased continuous-batch droputs. Pager channel: #incidents.
Alice R: seeing the same on dashboards — hundreds of 'kv:miss' noise. Any recent config pushes?
Ben S: I just pulled traces — severe kv churn correlated with a high NTK longctx rollout and YaRN batching policy change around 1795017900.
Priya K: confirmed — we flipped sliding_window=true for longctx for the NTK rollout two minutes before. Also YaRN autoscale bumped max_batch_tokens from 2048 -> 8192.
Diego: ow. Customers on Dedicated are starting to see generation errors? Any impact numbers?
Maya C: CS reporting 3 customers with error spikes and higher tail latency. One customer (acme-retail) opened a ticket complaining about timeouts. I'll prepare a short status to send.
Ben S: mitigation plan: 1) immediately disable sliding_window on the NTK longctx variant 2) revert YaRN batching max back to 2048 3) temporarily throttle continuous-batching to preserve cache hit ratio. Which one is fastest?
Priya K: fastest is toggling sliding_window flag (runtime config flip). Reverting YaRN requires a config push but can be done via rollout policy in 30s. Throttle can be applied via rate-limit / autoscaler override.
Alice R: do sliding_window flip now. Priya take lead. Ben monitor KV metrics and tail latency. Diego coordinate CS comms. Sam O (oncall infra) please stand by for rollback if needed.
Priya K: on it. Running:
```
# flip sliding_window off for NTK longctx variant
redwood-runtime cli set-config --model ntk-longctx --feature sliding_window false --env us-west-2
```
Priya K: submitted, applying patch to 4 nodes. Rolling restart not required — config hotflip should take effect within 10-20s.
Ben S: seeing eviction rate start to drop at ~1795018056. Cache size stabilizing. KV miss % down from 78% -> 31% and still falling. Latency tail improving. :thumbsup:
Maya C: sent customer note: "We're investigating elevated timeouts and have applied engine mitigation; we'll follow up in 30m with a status update."
Diego: good. Tracking impacted customers in the incident doc.
Alice R: next step revert YaRN batching to 2048 — Priya, can you push now? If it triggers regressions, we should rollback.
Priya K: pushing YaRN config rollback now via canary then global. Command:
```
redwood-svc rollout set yarn.max_batch_tokens=2048 --scope=us-west-2 --strategy=canary --steps=20%
```
Priya K: canary at 20% applied. Monitoring.
Ben S: metrics show further headroom after canary. No new cache bursts. Good signal.
Sam O: I'm increasing the autoscaler cooldown to reduce bursty attach/detach churn: set autoscale.cooldown=60s. Applying now.
Alice R: putting a temporary throttle on continuous-batching for the NTK tenant: 6 req/s per-worker. That reduces batch coalescing pressure.
Ben S: eviction rate back near baseline. I'll keep monitoring for 15m.
Priya K: canary to 100% completed at 1795018201. No regressions observed.
Maya C: updated customers with timeline + action items. One asks for a postmortem link once available.
Diego: assigning owner for follow-up: Ben S for metrics analysis, Priya K for root cause & rollback diff, Sam O for autoscale tuning, Alice R for postmortem writeup.
Alice R: handoff: I'm going offline in 10m, handing to Ben S for active monitoring for the next 2 hours. Ben, please call me if anything re-escalates.
Ben S: acknowledged — taking over. Will post update at +30m and +60m.
incident-bot: Incident status updated -> mitigated. Severity: Sev-2. Duration so far: ~6m.
Alice R: thanks all. Postmortem checklist: collect configs (pre/post), timeline of sliding_window toggle, YaRN diff, KV metrics (evictions, misses), sample traces, and customer impact table.
Priya K: saving diffs and uploading to the incident doc now.
Sam O: will propose an autoscale policy change to prevent similar attach/detach thrash.
Maya C: customers notified. I'll add link to CS tickets in the doc.
Ben S: will keep watch. If anything flares, reopen thread.
Diego: marking this as mitigated for now. Good job team. :tada:
